metas.name: Inside Out 2
metas.description: Since they enjoyed Turning Red, this sequel about managing complex growing emotions is a perfect fit.

metas.name: Inside Out
metas.description: A foundational Pixar movie about the personified emotions of a young girl, similar in tone to Turning Red.

metas.name: How to Train Your Dragon
metas.description: A high-flying adventure with a deep bond between a boy and a dragon, much like Raya and the Last Dragon.

metas.name: The Mitchells vs. the Machines
metas.description: A high-energy, visually unique family comedy that matches the style of Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse.

metas.name: Finding Nemo
metas.description: A classic underwater adventure about family and bravery that any fan of Migration or Moana will love.

metas.name: Monsters, Inc.
metas.description: A hilarious and heartwarming story about monsters who are actually afraid of children, fitting for fans of Despicable Me.

metas.name: The Incredibles
metas.description: Offers exciting superhero action and family dynamics similar to the Sonic the Hedgehog movies.

metas.name: Wreck-It Ralph
metas.description: Centering on video game characters, this is a must-watch for fans of The Super Mario Bros. Movie and Sonic.

metas.name: Luca
metas.description: A gentle and beautiful coming-of-age story set in Italy, sharing the whimsical nature of Studio Ghibli films.

metas.name: Elemental
metas.description: A visually stunning Pixar film about different elements living together, matching the colorful style of Encanto.

metas.name: Aladdin
metas.description: A classic Disney musical adventure with a magical genie that fans of Tangled and Moana will enjoy.

metas.name: The Little Mermaid
metas.description: Another cornerstone Disney musical with great songs and a focus on exploring new worlds.

metas.name: Beauty and the Beast
metas.description: A masterfully told fairy tale with beautiful animation and music, perfect for fans of Tangled.

metas.name: Mulan
metas.description: Features a strong female protagonist and epic adventure, much like Raya and the Last Dragon.

metas.name: Big Hero 6
metas.description: Combines high-tech action with a touching friendship between a boy and his robot, appealing to Sonic fans.

metas.name: The Princess and the Frog
metas.description: A lively musical set in New Orleans with great magic and humor, following the Disney tradition they like.

metas.name: Minions: The Rise of Gru
metas.description: A direct follow-up to Despicable Me focusing on the hilarious Minions they already enjoy.

metas.name: The Secret Life of Pets
metas.description: A funny look at what animals do when humans aren't home, similar in humor to Migration.

metas.name: Kung Fu Panda 3
metas.description: The next chapter in the series they've started, featuring more action and family discovery.

metas.name: Kung Fu Panda 4
metas.description: The latest installment of the franchise, keeping the comedy and martial arts action fresh.

metas.name: Trolls Band Together
metas.description: A music-heavy, colorful adventure that fans of Sing 2 and KPop Demon Hunters will find delightful.

metas.name: Leo
metas.description: A charming and funny animated musical about a class lizard that offers great laughs for the whole family.

metas.name: Abominable
metas.description: A magical journey across China to return a Yeti home, similar in spirit to Howl's Moving Castle.

metas.name: Over the Moon
metas.description: A beautiful musical fantasy inspired by Chinese mythology, appealing to fans of Moana and Coco.

metas.name: The Emperor's New Groove
metas.description: One of Disney's funniest and most quotable movies, matching the irreverent humor of Shrek.

metas.name: Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs
metas.description: A fast-paced, imaginative comedy that shares the high-energy vibe of The Super Mario Bros. Movie.

metas.name: Up
metas.description: A wonderful adventure featuring a floating house and a talking dog, capturing the magic of Pixar.

metas.name: Cars
metas.description: A fun, character-driven story about racing and friendship that appeals to younger fans of Sonic.

metas.name: Monsters University
metas.description: A fun prequel showing how Mike and Sulley became friends, expanding on a world they would enjoy.

metas.name: Incredibles 2
metas.description: Continues the superhero family action with modern animation and even more humor.

metas.name: Finding Dory
metas.description: A heartwarming sequel focusing on Dory's quest to find her parents, full of humor and ocean adventure.

metas.name: The Peanuts Movie
metas.description: A gentle and visually charming film that stays true to the classic characters, perfect for all ages.

metas.name: Paddington
metas.description: A live-action/CGI hybrid that is incredibly sweet and funny, fitting the family-friendly adventure criteria.

metas.name: Paddington 2
metas.description: Even better than the first, this is a masterpiece of family filmmaking that is kind, funny, and exciting.

metas.name: The Lego Movie
metas.description: A hilarious and creative adventure that celebrates imagination, similar to Toy Story.

metas.name: Wish
metas.description: A celebration of Disney's magical history with great songs and a classic hero vs. villain story.

metas.name: Ruby Gillman, Teenage Kraken
metas.description: A fun twist on mythical creatures that combines high school life with fantasy adventure.

metas.name: Lilo & Stitch
metas.description: A unique story about a girl and her 'dog' (an alien) that focuses heavily on the meaning of family.
